# The Swanson Law Group

> > Personal injury law firm with offices in San Jose, Westlake Village, and Houston, specializing in car accidents, wrongful death, brain injuries, and truck accidents throughout California and Texas.

Founded by trial lawyer Benjamin D. Swanson, the firm operates on a contingency fee basis and offers free consultations. The team includes attorneys like Greg Schaffer and provides bilingual services (English/Spanish) for personal injury victims across multiple practice areas.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Car Accidents & Hit-and-Run Claims
- Wrongful Death Cases
- Traumatic Brain Injuries (TBI)
- Truck Accidents
- California Vehicle Code & Civil Procedure
- Contingency Fee Representation
- San Jose Legal Services
- Westlake Village & Thousand Oaks
- Insurance Claims & Compensation
- Workplace Accidents (OSHA)
- Free Legal Consultation
- Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum
- Comparative Negligence in California
- Bilingual Legal Services (Español)
